_about: Registry of every strategy considered. Status: PROCEED (being paper traded or about to be), CANDIDATE (passed tests, awaiting your decision), PARKED (sound idea, blocked by venue or priority), REJECTED (failed tests; do not trade). bot.py stamps every bot_log.csv row with the ACTIVE id.

strategies.name: Flow Regime v1.0, spot long/flat (Alpaca)
strategies.evidence: 2023-26 out-of-sample: win 45%, Sharpe 1.48, max DD -18.6%, +28%/yr. Full: win 42%, DD -20.5%. Walk-forward 2022-now: +7.8%/yr, Sharpe 0.55, DD -26.8%. Monte Carlo 1-in-20 DD -34%. Beat plain trend rules out-of-sample.
strategies.next: Your sign-off (python signoff.py --approve), then paper trade 3-6 months against the survival limits.

strategies.name: Flow Regime v1.1 = v1.0 + take 1/3 profit at +2 ATR, rest to breakeven
strategies.evidence: Win 67% (2020-22) / 65% (2023-26); max DD -11% / -14%; Monte Carlo 1-in-20 DD -28%; +12% / +17% per yr. Every profit-take level tested raised win rate and cut drawdown. Lower return than S1 at equal risk.
strategies.next: Your choice vs S1. If chosen: walk-forward, Monte Carlo limits, new sign-off, bot partial-sell support.

strategies.name: Flow Regime perp long/short (bull long, bear short, range pause)
strategies.evidence: 2022 bear year about 0% vs -17% (S1) and -65% (BTC). But shorts added about 0 in 2023-26: crash insurance, not profit. Needs a venue that can short (IBKR CME micro futures or Coinbase/Kraken US perps).
strategies.next: Revisit after S1/S2 has a live paper record.

strategies.name: Order-book entry timing (limit orders when the book favours us)
strategies.evidence: Not tested. Could save a few basis points per trade on S1/S2 entries. Execution improvement, not a strategy.
strategies.next: Low priority; only after paper trading shows fill quality.

strategies.name: Order Book Imbalance (OBI) scalping, 2-4 tick targets
strategies.evidence: Fees about $76-380 per BTC round trip vs a $0.20-0.40 target: loses even at 100% win rate. Needs microsecond colocation; walls get spoofed. No tick-level book history to backtest.

strategies.name: Bollinger RSI Exhaustion (BB 20/2.5 + RSI7 <20/>80, exit at basis, 1.5 ATR stop)
strategies.evidence: BTC 1h as written: win 37-39%, -39% to -55%/yr, DD -86% to -88%. Loses even with zero fees (2023-26: -20%/yr, DD -66%). 4h: win 42%, -8%/yr, DD -38%. research_alternatives/bollinger_rsi_exhaustion.py

strategies.name: RSI dip-buying in uptrends (with and without flow filter)
strategies.source: Connors RSI(2)-style mean reversion; literature review
strategies.evidence: With flow filter: 0 of 108 configs profitable 2023-26. Without: 7% of 162 (Alpaca costs), 15% (perp costs); the IS-best config lost out-of-sample.

strategies.name: Funding carry / cash-and-carry basis trade
strategies.evidence: Best rule +2%/yr 2020-26, about 0% in 2025-26; other rules negative. Reports put 2026 basis yields below Treasury rates. Needs a perp account too.
strategies.next: Re-check only if funding stays strongly positive for months.

strategies.name: Plain trend following (above 200 EMA / 200-day average)
strategies.evidence: Looked best in 2020-22 (Sharpe 1.32) and collapsed in 2023-26 (Sharpe 0.50, DD -44%). 150-190 trades out-of-sample = fee drag. research_alternatives/trend_baselines.py
strategies.next: None. Kept as the benchmark S1 must keep beating.

strategies.name: Early v0: z-scored flow with 2-day holds
strategies.evidence: 2023-26 about flat (Sharpe 0.18); 151 trades at 0.6% round trip ate the edge.
strategies.next: None. Led to the slower S1 design.

strategies.name: Pairs trading / statistical arbitrage: ETH vs BTC (z-score of the spread, enter |z|>2, exit at 0)
strategies.source: AI-generated suggestion (screenshots); claimed market-neutral, low drawdown
strategies.evidence: Fails its own cointegration requirement: Engle-Granger ADF t = -1.2 (2020-22), -2.3 (2023-26), -2.5 (full) vs -3.34 needed; cointegrated in only 10% of rolling 1-year windows. As described (daily): win 13% / 42%, -31% / -16% per yr, DD -66% / -50%. Grid: 8% of 48 configs profitable 2023-26 on daily and 4h bars. ETH/BTC trended down for years, so 'buy the cheap one' kept losing. Needs shorting (not possible on Alpaca crypto). research_alternatives/pairs_btc_eth.py
strategies.next: None for BTC/ETH. Stock pairs (KO/PEP etc.) are a separate project: Alpaca can short stocks, but each pair must pass the same cointegration and out-of-sample tests.

rejected_rules: Exiting open trades when consolidation starts (hurt every variant)
